name: CPU/EPYC inference collapses unless every memory channel is populated
symptom: A Genoa box with ONE 64GB DIMM measured 1.5 tok/s on 34B Q4_0, jumping to 4 tok/s with a second stick - one DIMM wastes ~92% of the bandwidth you paid for.
root_cause: LLM decode is bandwidth-bound; server CPUs only reach their rated ~460 GB/s (Genoa 12ch) with a DIMM on every channel. A few fat DIMMs leave most channels idle.
workaround: Budget 12x 32GB or 12x 64GB, not 4x 96GB. Fully populated Genoa lands ~7 tok/s on 70B Q4_K_M. Dual-socket does NOT double it - NUMA splits to ~1.3-1.6x single-socket.
